summary:
ZENAUT is an astronaut wellbeing platform designed to support both physical and mental health during space missions. It brings essential crew-support tools together in one dashboard, with an offline-first design for situations where communication with Earth is delayed or unavailable.

The platform includes physical health monitoring, sleep tracking, mood and stress check-ins, breathing and grounding exercises, a personal journal, games, and ways to stay connected with loved ones. It also provides visual health indicators and alerts to help crew members notice potential concerns.

Long-duration missions expose astronauts to challenges such as isolation, disrupted sleep cycles, workload stress, and changes in bone and cardiovascular health. ZENAUT addresses these challenges by making daily wellbeing monitoring and self-care more accessible in one place.

Developed as a working web prototype, ZENAUT aims to support healthier, more resilient crews on missions to the Moon and Mars. Its potential applications also extend to isolated environments on Earth, including research stations and submarines.
details:
ZENAUT is an astronaut health monitoring and wellbeing platform designed to support crew members during long-duration space missions.

Spaceflight can affect astronauts physically and psychologically through microgravity, radiation exposure, disrupted sleep, cardiovascular changes, isolation and stress. ZENAUT brings multiple aspects of astronaut wellbeing together in one platform.

It includes modules for physical health monitoring, sleep and circadian rhythms, mood tracking, stress assessment, wellbeing reports, grounding exercises and astronaut support features. Interactive dashboards, graphs and reports help users observe health trends over time.

The platform aims to support early identification of concerning changes and make relevant health information accessible to astronauts and authorised medical teams. Future development could include integration with existing spaceflight monitoring devices and real-time alert systems.

Built using Python, Flask, HTML, CSS and JavaScript, ZENAUT follows a modular design that allows additional features and integrations to be developed.

Our vision is to contribute to safer, healthier and more sustainable human space exploration by addressing both the physical and mental wellbeing of astronauts.
